Choose a meeting plan that is allowed by EVERY constraint below. The answer must occur in ALL THREE lists, not merely in one or two. Find their set intersection and check your selected plan against each list. Exactly one plan is common to all three lists. All evidence is available here; no other agent is needed.
e8e67 (attendee availability): plan_2, plan_3, plan_4, plan_5
ee090 (venue availability): plan_2, plan_3, plan_7, plan_8
ee0fe (equipment availability): plan_1, plan_3, plan_4, plan_8
Return ONLY JSON with this structure: {"action":"submit_report","params":{"plan_id":"plan ID","evidence_ids":["all three evidence IDs"]}}. Use the actual IDs above.
